source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 按截图峰位与多峰形态估计的混合高斯示例轮廓；不是原始细胞表达数据
provenance.en: Gaussian-mixture demonstration curves approximating visible modes; not original cell measurements.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 每个细胞/event 的 CD161、NKG2A、CD31、CD8、CD57、CD28 表达，以及样本与 c1–c8 群标签。
Vγ9Vδ2/Vδ1 群的定义、预处理变换、门控/聚类方法和 All cells 的组成。
原始样本权重及中位数的计算规则；不能从峰高推断细胞数量。
en: Per-cell/event CD161, NKG2A, CD31, CD8, CD57 and CD28 expression, with sample IDs and c1–c8 labels.
Vγ9Vδ2/Vδ1 definitions, preprocessing transformation, gating/clustering and composition of All cells.
Sample weights and the median convention; peak height does not identify the number of cells.

preprocessing.zh: 先确定细胞群和表达变换，再提供 marker/group/value 或 x/density。新数据的中位线由输入分布估计，不沿用截图中位线。
preprocessing.en: Define populations and expression transformation upstream; supply marker/group/value or x/density. Replacement-data median lines are estimated from input distributions rather than reused from the screenshot.

description.zh: 通道对应的 marker 名称
description.en: Marker corresponding to the measurement channel

description.zh: 实验组或细胞群；与样式一致
description.en: Experimental group or cell population; match style

description.zh: 已转换的横轴坐标；不是原始特征矩阵
description.en: Transformed x coordinate, not a raw feature matrix

description.zh: 分布的展示高度，不是样本量
description.en: Display height of a distribution, not sample count
